guarantees.claim: data_i_transposed is always equal to aes_transpose(data_i).
data_o is always equal to aes_transpose(data_o_transposed).

uncertain_points.claim: The correctness of the AES mix columns output depends on the implementation of the aes_transpose function, which is not defined in this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: If aes_transpose is incorrectly defined, data_o will be incorrectly transposed, breaking the entire AES round operation.

uncertain_points.claim: The signal data_o_transposed is driven by other logic (the actual mix columns computation) and its correctness is not ensured by this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: If data_o_transposed is incorrect, the final output data_o will be wrong, compromising the cipher output.
